instruction: A candid outdoor full-shot photograph captures a couple on a rocky beach shoreline with ocean waves and sand in the background. The man in the light blue shirt (R1) stands on the left, slightly behind, wearing black pants and looking forward with a neutral expression. Beside him, the blonde woman in the pink floral dress (R2) stands in the foreground on the right, looking off-camera to the right. The man (R1) stands closely behind and to the left of the woman (R2) on the uneven rocks, their hands positioned close together. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused overcast light, creating cool blue and grey tones that contrast with the vibrant pink of the dress.
